Seabound is raising a Series A round to scale-up the team, technology, and commercial deployments.

# Oceanium
Seaweed biorefinery for food, materials and biodegradable products

Processes farmed kelp into food ingredients, biodegradable materials and other products through its biorefinery technology.

Oceanium is an impact business formed to enable the emerging sustainably-farmed seaweed industry. We do this by creating products including all-natural nutraceuticals, food ingredients and bio-packaging materials for the high-growth plant-based foods and circular life cycle packaging markets. Our biorefinery is at TRL 6-8 for various of our nutraceutical and food products, with packaging at TRL 3/4. Kelp-EU is designed to enable scale-up of our operation where we process and sell the out put of 150 tonnes of farmed seaweed.

Location: Oban, United Kingdom
Stage: seed
